name: popsicle
headline: LeadCMS.ai - AI-Powered CMS & CRM for SaaS
short_description: LeadCMS.ai offers an intuitive admin UI for managing landing pages and content, helping SaaS teams to enhance lead generation with AI-driven tools. Streamline your marketing efforts and boost productivity with this powerful CMS and CRM solution.
author: LeadCMS

sections.overview:
OnlineSales.admin is a React-based admin interface for OnlineSales, a lightweight and extendable headless CMS built for product websites. The admin UI provides a user-friendly interface for managing site content without being tied to a specific frontend framework. Built with modern tooling (Node 18+), it supports quick setup and local development. The project is actively maintained and designed for teams looking for a flexible, customizable CMS solution that separates content management from presentation layer concerns.
Create and manage landing pages effortlessly
Automate content updates for campaigns
Analyze lead generation metrics
Integrate with existing SaaS tools
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install LeadCMS/leadcms.admin`
`git clone https://github.com/LeadCMS/leadcms.admin`
sections.usage:
```
Use LeadCMS.ai's admin UI to [ACTION] for [PROJECT/TEAM]. Specifically, [SPECIFIC_TASK] such as updating [LANDING_PAGE_ELEMENT], analyzing [CONTENT_PERFORMANCE_METRIC], or configuring [AI_TOOL_SETTING]. Ensure the changes align with [MARKETING_GOAL] and [BRAND_GUIDELINES].
```
Copy

```
For the 'SaaS Growth Summit 2024' landing page under the Marketing team's LeadCMS.ai workspace, I updated the hero section to feature a new AI-powered demo video (replacing the static screenshot) and adjusted the CTA button from 'Watch Demo' to 'Get Early Access' to better align with the Q3 lead gen campaign. The page’s conversion rate improved from 2.1% to 3.8% within 48 hours, as tracked in LeadCMS.ai’s analytics dashboard. Additionally, I enabled the AI-driven A/B testing tool to automatically rotate the headline variants between 'Unlock 30% More Leads' and 'Scale Your Pipeline with AI' every 2 hours. The tool flagged that the 'AI-Powered Demo' variant had a 12% higher click-through rate, so I paused the other variant and set it as the default. Finally, I configured the CRM integration to tag all leads from this page with 'Summit 2024' and sync their scores to HubSpot, where the sales team can prioritize follow-ups based on engagement heatmaps. The admin UI’s real-time preview confirmed all changes were live without requiring a developer review.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
